use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: The C2 JU exchanges IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) with another JU using the applicable J-series messages.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The C2 JU exchanges IFF/SIF transponder data (Modes I, II, and III codes) with another JU using the applicable J-series messages.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: Using a J3.1 or J3.5 (PTI=0) message, C2 JU exchanges available IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes with another JU, completing the exchange.
scope_contract.start_boundary: IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes are available to exchange.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been exchanged in the applicable J-series message.
in_scope_actions: Transmit available IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages
Exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes in J7.5 (ACT=2) messages
excluded_adjacent_actions: Post-exchange processing of received IFF/SIF data (e.g., correlation, display, track management)
Administrative setup or configuration of transponder data exchange
variant_dimensions: Message type (J3.1/J3.5 standard surveillance data vs J7.5 special-meaning codes)
IFF/SIF functional area (Surveillance Data Reporting, Unique Mode II Code Protection, Clearing IFF/SIF Data, Difference Resolution, Update Request)

claims.content: C2 JU
IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) are available.
For the J7.5 Update Request function, the initiating C2 JU has the applicable mode indicators set.
For an exchange of special-meaning IFF/SIF codes, the C2 JU holds the special code data to be transmitted.

The use case is triggered when IFF/SIF surveillance data (Modes I, II, and III codes) becomes available to exchange in J3.1/J3.5 (PTI=0) messages, or when a J7.5 IFF/SIF data-management/reporting action is initiated (e.g., an operator transmits an ACT=2 Update Request or the R² unit reports a No Data status for one or more modes).
The C2 JU, as the reporting unit with R² responsibility, has IFF/SIF Modes I, II, and III codes available for the track.
The C2 JU transmits the available IFF/SIF data in a J3.1 or J3.5 (PTI=0) message, periodically reporting the valid data held for the track.
The other JU without R² monitors the periodic surveillance data transmitted by the C2 JU.
Diverges from Step 2: The C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=3) Special Code message to exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes.

Diverges from Step 2: The C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=2) IFF/SIF Update Request, initiated by operator action, to request updated transponder data from another unit; receiving units respond by transmitting their local data codes.

Diverges from Step 2: The C2 JU may transmit a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report to report a difference in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix; this transmission may be initiated by operator action at any time.

Diverges from Step 2: Instead of transmitting valid IFF/SIF data, the C2 JU (as the R² unit) may report a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required IFF/SIF Surveillance data report (J3.XC1), spontaneously triggering a data update; receiving units holding valid nonzero data respond as required by the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.

Diverges from Step 2: Instead of continuing to report valid IFF/SIF data, the C2 JU (as the R² unit) may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message to clear one or more modes on the specified track, including all modes or the Mode II code; this results in no IFF/SIF data being held on that track, causes the C2 JU to stop transmitting the periodic J3 message containing the continuation word for that track, and upon receipt all JUs automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to No Data status.

missing_aspects: Unique Mode II Code Protection alternative path is not supported by the supplied evidence cards.

claims.content: At main_flow Step 3, if the receiving JU detects a data difference because its locally entered IFF/SIF data changed from zero to nonzero or from nonzero to another nonzero value, or because it received a J3.XC1 surveillance report containing a 'NO DATA' condition (value 0 in the applicable Mode Code field) for one or more modes while it holds local nonzero IFF/SIF, it may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report in accordance with the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.

At main_flow Step 2, if the R² C2 JU identifies an ID conflict, the operator is alerted, and the R² C2 JU continues to report the local ID data in the applicable surveillance message with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1; the conflict is resolved by manual means.

At main_flow Step 3, if the operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert, the operator may attempt resolution by: updating local data manually or verifying automatic inputs; initiating a J7.5 (ACT=0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); initiating a J7.5 (ACT=1) IFF/SIF Difference Report (any mode); changing local data to agree with remote data except in the case of a Mode II code; decorrelating local data (which assigns a new track number to local data); or clearing the operator alert (any mode).
At any time during the exchange (including at main_flow Step 3), the operator may initiate a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report to resolve a discrepancy, even without a system-generated conflict alert.

missing_aspects: No supplied evidence defines an automatic resumption/recovery step after an operator-selected conflict-resolution action; continuation must be inferred from the selected J7.5 action or local update.
No supplied evidence covers exception handling specific to the J7.5 special-meaning code exchange branch (ACT=3).
No supplied evidence supports a dedicated Unique Mode II Code Protection exception beyond the 'except Mode II' manual-action constraint.
No supplied evidence supports an exception flow for a pending J7.5 Data Update Request when an R² shift occurs.
Explicit definition of the exit state or handoff mechanism following the initiation of the report.
Explicit definition of the exit state or termination condition for the manual resolution process.
Explicit definition of the branch termination or handoff conditions associated with selecting specific actions.
Explicit definition of the exit state or handoff mechanism following the manual initiation.

claims.content: The IFF/SIF transponder data has been successfully exchanged in the applicable J-series message (e.g., J3.1/J3.5 for surveillance data or J7.5 for management actions).
Units receiving a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message respond by transmitting their local data codes.

Upon receipt of a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message, all JUs automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to No Data status. A JU with R² that results in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data.

After successful completion of a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report transmission, the reported difference is communicated to relevant units, and the act of transmission itself completes the exchange function.

missing_aspects: No supplied evidence defines the immediate success state specific to a J7.5 (ACT=3) Special Code exchange.
No supplied evidence defines the postcondition for the Unique Mode II Code Protection functional area.
